title: Estimates of Expenditure of Singapore for the Financial Year 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027
what_it_is: Estimates of Expenditure of Singapore for the Financial Year 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027

sections.label: Estimates debate guillotine times
sections.summary: The passage states totals for each Head of Expenditure in the FY2026 Main and Development Estimates, notes 425 amendments submitted, and explains guillotine times under Standing Order 92(7)(a).

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: For convenience, I shall take the totals for each Head of Expenditure in the Main and Development Estimates as they appear in the last columns of the schedules of estimated expenditure under the Main and Development Estimates Outlays for FY2026 on pages 6 and 7 respectively of the Command Paper.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: A total of 425 amendments to the Estimates of Expenditure have been submitted this year.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: The guillotine times to the discussion of the Heads of Expenditure under Standing Order 92(7)(a) have taken into consideration the earlier commencement time of a Sitting, the reduction of Question Time and the extension of sitting times of the Committee of Supply for each allotted day.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: I must remind hon Members that the total time for discussion of each Head of Expenditure includes the replies from the front bench.

sections.label: Microphone mute and amendments order
sections.summary: The passage states a hope that muting a microphone will not be needed and that Heads of Expenditure with amendments on the Order Paper Supplement will be dealt with first.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: And I certainly hope I do not have to do this — which will mute your microphone.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: I shall deal first with the Heads of Expenditure in respect of which amendments stand on the Order Paper Supplement.
